summary.text: Trevor Currier is the Republican candidate for the Massachusetts House of Representatives, 20th Middlesex District, in the November 3, 2026 general election, against Democrat Joseph Markey.
Ballotpedia lists him as an officeholder of the Masconomet Regional School District in Middleton, and he advanced from the Republican primary on September 1, 2026.
